mapper.select: SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.BOOKSET_FULLNAME AS booksetFullname, A.BOOKSET_NAME AS booksetName, A.BOOKSET_TYPE AS booksetType, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS acctSubjectId, A.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcy, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS acctSubjectType, A.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AS booksetIdTmpl, A.ACCT_STANDARD AS acctStandard, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.END_DATE AS endDate, bbp.BOOKSET_SCHEME_ID As booksetSchemeId, bbp.scheme_id as schemeId, bbp2.BOOKSET_SCHEME_ID As booksetTaxSchemeId, bbp2.scheme_id as taxSchemeId, bbp3.BOOKSET_SCHEME_ID As booksetShadowPriceSchemeId, bbp3.scheme_id as shadowPriceSchemeId, to_char(BD.bookset_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS bookSetDate FROM BOK_BOOKSET A left join bok_bookset_plan bbp on bbp.bookset_id = A.BOOKSET_ID /**modify jinmaodong 20180911 需要加类型进行区分：01-估值方案；02-税务方案**/ AND bbp.SCHEME_TYPE = '01' left join bok_bookset_plan bbp2 on bbp2.bookset_id = A.BOOKSET_ID /**modify huangjian 20190105 02-税务方案**/ AND bbp2.SCHEME_TYPE = '02' left join bok_bookset_plan bbp3 on bbp3.bookset_id = A.BOOKSET_ID /**modify huangjian 20190105 03-影子定价方案**/ AND bbp3.SCHEME_TYPE = '03' left join bok_VAL_SCHEME s on s.scheme_id = bbp.scheme_id and s.scheme_id = bbp2.scheme_id and s.scheme_id = bbp3.scheme_id LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE BD ON A.BOOKSET_ID = BD.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
